firstPlayerRule: After everyone chooses a character, take the chosen characters' bandit figures and pick one at random; that bandit's player is the First Player for the first round.
clarifications: Starting with the First Player and going clockwise, players place their bandits in the caboose and the adjacent car.
Within a round, turns start with the First Player and go clockwise.
At the end of each round, the player to the left of the First Player takes the Round deck and becomes the new First Player.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the English rules from Ludonaute's data server (same folder as the French 2016 rules linked from https://www.ludonaute.fr/portfolio/colt-express/); SHA-256 99a7b3e1bd71c738bbedef6cc1a01215200e9d5b5902377f25b80dc78d3d1645, 7 PDF pages laid out as two-page spreads. Printed page 3 (PDF 2): take the chosen characters' bandit figures, randomly choose 1, and that player is the First Player for the first round; bandits are placed clockwise from the First Player. Printed pages 4-5 (PDF 3): turns start with the First Player clockwise, and the player to the left of the First Player becomes the new First Player at round end. Credits read 2016 Ludonaute; train, bandits and Marshal match Colt Express BGG 158899. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The 2-bandits-per-player variant for 2-3 players was not checked for a different opening procedure.
